latest.title: Are We Really Any Different From The Past?
latest.desc:
Are we really any different from the past?

Historians Nigel Biggar and Robert Tombs discuss why we shouldn't be so shocked by the darker parts of human history, and how modern society isn't as different from the past as we like to think.
